user.title: Connect 1pMobile
user.description: Enter your 1pMobile website login. The integration reads the Calls and Texts usage pages and account credit.

init.title: 1pMobile options
init.description: Contacts: enter one mapping per line as phone number = display name. If Enter submits the form, use Shift+Enter or paste the mappings from a text editor. Notification service example: notify.mobile_app_your_phone. The summary is sent on the first successful update each local day.
